description: Quickly and effortlessly execute a saved test case from .androidmcp-framework/testcases/. Automatically executes each step, continuously audits UI responsiveness, design/layout issues, data anomalies (null/NaN/undefined), and logcat exceptions along the way, and generates a timestamped report.

assertionTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for an explicit expectedOutcome to appear; default 3000ms. UI actions are not retried.

auditEachStep.description: Continuously monitor screen for design/data/crash issues during execution (default true).

captureFailureEvidence.description: Capture screenshot and hierarchy evidence for failed steps (default true).

projectPath.description: Project root directory; defaults to cwd.

stopOnFailure.description: Stop immediately if a step fails (default false).

targetId.description: Target Android device ID; defaults to session default.

targetRetries.description: Retry semantic target lookup before an action; default 2. Actions are never blindly retried.

name: run_test_case
title: Run Test Case
